name: codex
description: Delegate a task or question to OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.x) and relay its answer.

name: codex-check
description: Check that the Codex CLI is installed, on PATH, and authenticated for the adapter.

name: codex-critique
description: Get an independent Codex critique / second opinion on a decision, design, or plan (read-only).

name: codex-diagnose
description: Have Codex root-cause a failure without changing files (read-only).

name: codex-implement
description: Have Codex make a bounded code change and verify it (edits the working tree).

name: codex-research
description: Have Codex research a question using web search, with citations (read-only).

name: codex-review
description: Run an adversarial Codex code review of the current changes (read-only).

name: disable-for-project
description: Explain how to turn the code-intel stack OFF for the current repo (so it doesn't start serena/CBM here), without affecting other projects.

name: doctor
description: Diagnose the code-intel stack — check that serena, CBM, and ast-grep resolve, whether this repo is indexed, and print fix-up exports if a binary is missing.

name: index-repo
description: Index the current repo into CBM (and confirm serena activation) so graph queries work. Run once per repo; CBM auto-syncs after.

name: setup
description: One-time per-machine setup for the code-intel stack — auto-detect serena/CBM/ast-grep, wire up the CODE_INTEL_*_BIN env vars, and print install commands for anything missing.
